// Negative-control fixture for TestRealSocketDetector: an untagged test file
// that opens a real loopback listener. The self-test copies it into a scratch
// module as a _test.go file and requires the walker to flag it. It is a .txt
// file so the go tool never builds it here.

package x

import (
	"net"
	"testing"
)

func TestOpensARealSocket(t *testing.T) {
	ln, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	_ = ln.Close()
}
